sonnet.problem: This fill-in-the-blank asks the baker to supply the next word of a line they haven't seen: "as well as Aaron and ___." Card 5 never mentions Moses, Aaron or Miriam. The baker can only recall the name, not reason it out from the earlier cards.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
